entities.name: Large ribosomal subunit protein bL25
observations: The 204-aa query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt Q92N68 from Rhizobium meliloti strain 1021.
Annotated as a 5S rRNA-binding constituent of the large ribosomal subunit central protuberance, supporting a role in translation.
Pfam detects Ribosomal_L25p (PF01386.25, residues 7–94) and Ribosomal_TL5_C (PF14693.12, residues 103–186).
